## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Sri Venkateswara Diagnostic & Scans?
No. 320, Flat A1, Sakthi Elegance Apartment, Velachery Main Road, Velachery, Chennai 600 042 (Next to the police station).

### What facilities does Sri Venkateswara Diagnostic & Scans have?
Pathology lab, X-ray, MRI, CT scan, Ultrasound, ECG, Cardiology, Gastroenterology (endoscopy), Preventive health check-ups, Physiotherapy, Counselling & psychology, Online reports, ISO 9001:2015.

### Can I get my report online?
Yes. Reports are available through the 'Find Report' link on our website.

### What scans do you offer?
Our radiology department offers X-rays, MRIs, CT scans, ultrasounds and more.

### How do I book a test at Sri Venkateswara Diagnostic & Scans?
Pick your date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 99410 03980.
